draft.emotion: rushed and slightly breathless, with a packed schedule
notes: Druk is used both for people who have a lot to do and for places that are full of activity or people.
Do not confuse druk (busy) with dronk (drank) or droog (dry).

senses.definition: Having a lot of things to do; very occupied.

examples.text: Ik heb het vandaag erg druk op mijn werk.
examples.translation: I am very busy at work today.
examples.emotion: stressed about time, rushing to finish tasks

examples.text: Het is erg druk in de stad op zaterdag.
examples.translation: It is very busy in the city on Saturday.
examples.emotion: navigating through a sea of people with slight annoyance

senses.definition: Moving around a lot or behaving with high energy, often used for children.

examples.text: De kinderen zijn vandaag erg druk.
examples.translation: The children are very hyperactive today.
examples.emotion: exhausted by children running around the room
